name: Cerecinos de Campos (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below, charged towards the hoist with the crowned arms of Cerecinos de Campos.
history: Municipal flag of Cerecinos de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: narrow band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Cerecinos de Campos arms — Maltese cross on red and bezants on blue
crown and bezants of the arms
